ideas.name: Per-action software and AI options
ideas.summary: Define agent-led, hybrid, software-first exception and deterministic alternatives per action and supported input class.

ideas.name: Evidence-based candidate comparison and merge
ideas.summary: Run alternative interpretations or software routes where useful; align their records, compare evidence and preserve per-feature provenance when a reasoning VLM proposes selection or combination.

ideas.name: Per-feature tolerance and intended-use requirements
ideas.summary: Separate dimensional accuracy, geometry detail, appearance, function, simulation and manufacturing requirements; attach tolerances to individual features and relationships.
ideas.next_check: Review the first-point requirement and tolerance record without introducing a sample design.

ideas.name: Tested replacement of specific agent actions
ideas.summary: Specify and test repeatable software functions for particular input classes while preserving agent-assisted exception routes.
